messages:
alex_h: heads up — p99 for /v1/chat-stream jumped from ~260ms -> ~720ms after the kernel canary rolled. telemetry_bot flagged it. small-seq routes worst hit. anyone digging?
telemetry_bot: automated alert: route=/v1/chat-stream p99 increased 2.8x; kv_cache_miss_rate +18%; avg_batch_size -12%. dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/routes/chat-stream (canary window)
priya_m: @alex_h which kernel/build was rolled?
alex_h: rolled kernel build v3.4.1 at 2312345600 (auto-canary, 10% of traffic). no other runtime config changes at deploy time.
mateo_k: adding context — we also merged the new batching heuristic that prefers latency-bins for seq_len < 64 (to avoid padding). could be causing more small batches to be scheduled separately? v3.4.1 also has the asm-fused memcpy path change.
erin_ops: saw KV eviction spikes around 2312345648-2312345660 for the same route. kv_lookup latency p99 up too.
alex_h: quick profile summary from a noisy canary trace (p99):
```route=/v1/chat-stream seq_len~12
p99 breakdown (ms): compute=420, kv_lookup=180, memcpy=60, scheduling/queue=60
baseline (pre-roll v3.4.0): compute=240, kv_lookup=80, memcpy=20, scheduling=20
```
priya_m: that kv_lookup delta is concerning. could be a subtle change in cache key normalization / eviction because of kernel memory alignment change.
mateo_k: hypothesis: new batching heuristic reduces batch coalescing for tiny sequences -> smaller batches -> fewer cache hits per batch (prefix caching gets less reuse). also asm-mem path could increase memcpy tail latency for certain alignments.
priya_m: can we quickly tag metrics by kernel_build and batching_policy in the console? without that attribution we're blind.
alex_h: agree. immediate ask: add kernel_build and batching_policy as dimensions on the per-route KPI card (p50/p95/p99 + throughput + error_rate) and add seq_len buckets [1-16,17-64,65-256] so we can slice.
erin_ops: i'll kick a quick revert if it looks catastrophic.
deploybot: Revert rollout of kernel v3.4.1 -> v3.4.0 initiated at 2312345680. status: in-progress.
telemetry_bot: quick ad-hoc prometheus-ish query to validate per-kernel p99 by seq bucket (run in console query):
```quantile_over_time(0.99, route_latency_seconds{route="/v1/chat-stream",seq_bucket="1-16",kernel_build!=""}[5m]) by (kernel_build)```
mateo_k: for the longer term: propose schema changes to ingest pipeline: add `kernel_build`, `batching_policy` and `seq_len_bucket` tags on the route metrics, and expose KV metrics: kv_miss_rate, kv_eviction_count, kv_lookup_p99. also add kernel_build to trace/span attrs.
priya_m: UX ask: surface an alert on Console route card: when p99 increases >1.5x baseline AND kv_miss_rate delta >10% for same window. avoids false positives from traffic bursts.
alex_h: next steps: 1) finish revert and validate p99 returns to baseline; 2) add kernel_build + batching_policy + seq_len_bucket to per-route cards (p50/p95/p99 + throughput + errs); 3) add nightly job to backfill kernel tags for recent builds; 4) create a perf-test that reproduces small-seq profile to catch this in CI. i'll open PRs for console + telemetry.
priya_m: thanks — i'll own the alert rule and sampling buckets in telemetry.
mateo_k: i'll dig into the memcpy change and run microbenchmarks for alignment patterns.
erin_ops: I'll watch the revert roll and post results.
alex_h: :thumbsup: will post a short postmortem if revert doesn't fully resolve.
telemetry_bot: note: I'll create a temporary dashboard slice for /v1/chat-stream showing kernel_build dimension — link will be posted when ready.
deploybot: Revert completed at 2312345692; traffic back to v3.4.0 canary. monitoring: p99 trending down, kv_miss_rate recovering.
alex_h: early numbers look good — p99 back to ~280ms. closing the urgent channel but keeping the console work on the board.
priya_m: filing console-ux ticket: add seq_len slices + kernel tag to per-route KPI card.
mateo_k: sharing microbench results in #eng-runtime later.
erin_ops: thx all.
